summary: Reserve generation receipts in a configured runtime-owned directory (unit 7f-4)

replay.detail: No replay changes; an empty reservation is not a completed outcome or permission to rerun.

schema.detail: No persistent schema or shared writer changes.

rules.detail: INACTIVE before 4c-2 and explicit activation. Receipt directory comes from configuration with no default. Intent is durably recorded before directory/file side effects and before J.

compatibility.detail: Outcome names use the same job hash and generation as cgroup_name. The runtime creates or validates a caller-owned mode-0700 receipt directory and reserves its mode-0600 file with O_EXCL. Component-wise descriptor-relative O_NOFOLLOW traversal rejects symlink ancestors; existing destinations, insecure directories and mismatched recorded paths are refused. B6 atomically replaces the reservation with its outcome.

manual.detail: Pilot cap ceilings remain explicit caller JobScopePlan inputs. Pilot configuration supplies MemoryHigh 14G, MemoryMax 16G and swap 0; tasks, deadline and max-hold ceiling are also configured. Gate-slot verify independently refuses loose caps.

recovery.detail: Existing generation fencing and receipt identity checks remain. Tests cover exclusive reservation, naming, absent configuration, symlink ancestors/destination, directory permissions and intent-before-J ordering. Cargo and native execution not run.
